title: Stage 1 — move core/src/explore/ into a new explore/ workspace crate

plan.objective: Extract core/src/explore/ (11 modules + embedded prompt, ~3,900 lines) into a new workspace crate grove-explore-core, making grove-cst a pure structural library by storing the explore section of GroveConfig as an opaque serde_json::Value.
key_changes: Create explore/ workspace crate with Cargo.toml (lib, name=grove_explore_core, deps: grove-cst, ureq, serde, serde_json, anyhow, dirs)
Move all 11 modules + prompts/ from core/src/explore/ to explore/src/ byte-identical except mechanical import changes
toolset.rs: change `use crate::ops` → `use grove_core::ops` (only non-trivial import change)
Remove core/src/explore/ entirely; remove pub mod explore from core/src/lib.rs and its re-exports
Change GroveConfig.explore: Option<ExploreConfig> → Option<serde_json::Value> (opaque to core)
Rewrite migrate_from_legacy_explore in core/src/config.rs to pure JSON key-rename (mode→steering) without typed parse
Drop Eq derive from GroveConfig (serde_json::Value is not Eq); adapt config round-trip tests to Value assertions
Adapt core/src/doctor.rs: remove health_probe/HealthError/toolset imports; inline tool constants; drop HTTP health-probe checks; adapt explore_checks to Option<&serde_json::Value>
Add explore to Cargo.toml workspace.members
Add grove-explore-core dep to cli/Cargo.toml
cli/src/mcp.rs: update imports + add serde_json::from_value deserialization for grove_cfg.explore
cli/src/init.rs, tap.rs, config_tui/model.rs, trace_tui/model.rs: import path updates

review_plan.objective: Adversarially reviewed the plan to move core/src/explore/ into a new grove-explore-core crate and make GroveConfig.explore an opaque serde_json::Value.
key_changes: APPROVED: architecturally sound — opaque Option<serde_json::Value> for GroveConfig.explore correctly avoids a circular grove-cst <-> grove-explore-core dep.
Verified toolset::READ/GLOB/GREP = 'Read'/'Glob'/'Grep'; the plan's inlined doctor.rs literals match exactly (no behavior change).
Verified version pin: workspace is 0.4.1; proposed grove-explore-core = { version = '=0.4.1' } mirrors the existing grove-cst pin.
Verified include_str!('prompts/explore_v2.system.md') is source-relative and stays valid after the move (plan agrees, no change needed).
Verified GroveConfig::validate() only checks version==1, so the opaque explore section removes no validate()-time coverage.
Verified new crate's mod.rs public surface already re-exports every symbol the CLI imports; mirroring into explore/src/lib.rs covers all consumers.
ADVISORY 1: CLI inventory incomplete — config_tui/mod.rs, config_tui/update.rs, model.rs L4 also import grove_core explore/ExploreConfig/Provider/Steering; absent from plan's table, must repoint.
ADVISORY 2: mcp.rs uses NoopReporter (L374) beyond the L15-16 block; repointed use must also cover run_explore_reporting, ExploreConfig, ExploreError, OpenAiCompatClient, health_probe.
ADVISORY 3: JSON key-rename in migrate_from_legacy_explore defers Provider/Steering validation to CLI deserialize; malformed legacy files migrate silently — minor AC3 delta, note in PROGRESS.
ADVISORY 4: AC4 byte-identity diff summary in PROGRESS.md should show toolset.rs's crate::ops->grove_core::ops as the sole non-path delta and path-only for the rest.
Testing strategy is adequate: workspace build/test/clippy, cargo tree -p grove-cst | grep explore empty, byte-identity diffs, legacy-migration smoke test, --release --locked build.
